prerequisites: None. Recommended are the competencies taught in the modules Algorithms and Data Structures and Efficient Algorithms.

learning_outcomes.text: Students can present and discuss typical questions from bioinformatics and their formalization.
Students can use and adapt elementary algorithms in bioinformatics.
Students can design and evaluate solutions for new questions and problem variants.
Students can apply scientific working methods (recognizing, formulating, solving problems, abstraction).
Students are able to speak freely about scientific content, both in front of an audience and in a discussion.

syllabus_topics: Algorithmic problems and their solutions motivated by bioinformatics

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise assignments
Written exam or oral examination (individual examination)

assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments must be achieved, along with an oral presentation of the solution for at least two of the exercise assignments. The final grade is awarded from 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science degree program.
bibliography: Durbin, Eddy, Krogh, Mitchison. Biological Sequence Analysis.
Compeau, Pevzner. Bioinformatics Algorithms: An Active Learning Approach.
